zh-CN.title: 数字交锋独立房间
items: 进入独立对战房间后，双方按较低等级共同确认积分档位
统一入场投入与结算规则：胜者获得双方投入，平局或异常结束退款，取消首场保护
新增专属邀请卡片和推理桌面背景，好友通过链接入场，无需房间号

en.title: Dedicated Code Duel rooms
items: Enter a dedicated room and agree on a tier unlocked by both players
Both commit entry points; the winner receives both entries, with refunds for draws or abnormal endings and no first-match protection
A crafted room background and dedicated invitation cards let friends join without room codes
